$comment: Source of truth for skill-pack coverage of the US Wealth Management Capability Catalog. Regenerate CATALOG_CROSSWALK.md and SKILL.md catalog blocks with `npm run catalog`.

sections.T: Executable skills, tools and commercial platforms

tiers.engine: A library function implements the core calculation or check for this item.
tiers.partial-engine: A library function covers a stated part; the rest is guidance.
tiers.payload-builder: Builds request payloads locally; nothing is connected or submitted.
tiers.guidance: SKILL.md workflow guidance with no engine code.
tiers.standard-reference: A specification or rule the pack cites; not implemented.
tiers.integration-reference: An open-source project named as an optional integration.
tiers.research-reference: A paper cited as methodology or evidence.
